thread:
mira: :rotating_light: Alert from autoscaler: GPU pool 'rw-eu-gpu-1' at 100% utilization, queue backlog rising. new_queue: 128 -> scaling attempted but hit max_nodes=24, remaining queue = 94. observed increased driver Xid errors on 3 nodes.

oncall-bot: Pager triggered to @devin (eng-sre). Severity: P1. Affected customers: 2 active Dedicated tenants in eu-west-1.

devin: I'm on it, grabbing the node list and current autoscale events. Can someone post the output of `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=gpu-pool=rw-eu-gpu-1`?

mira: Pasting clipped output from the autoscaler logs: 
```
2026-03-15T09:07:12Z autoscaler: scale_request nodes=6 -> 8 reason=queue_growth
2026-03-15T09:08:55Z autoscaler: scale_request nodes=8 -> 12 reason=queue_growth
2026-03-15T09:11:03Z autoscaler: scale_request nodes=12 -> 16 reason=queue_growth
2026-03-15T09:14:01Z autoscaler: scale_request nodes=16 -> 24 reason=queue_growth
2026-03-15T09:16:12Z autoscaler: scale_request nodes=24 -> 24 reason=max_reached
2026-03-15T09:16:25Z node-manager: node/ai-gpu-07 reporting CUDA_ERROR Xid 61, evicting pods
2026-03-15T09:16:40Z node-manager: node/ai-gpu-09 reporting CUDA_ERROR Xid 43, driver restart
2026-03-15T09:17:05Z autoscaler: backlog=94 tokens/sec aligned with pending requests
```

jordan: Node evictions + driver restarts are dropping effective capacity. If nodes are cycling, autoscaler sees them as unavailable and can't allocate more because account-level quota is hit.

sam: Confirming: account GPU quota at cloud provider is 24 for this region. We tried to scale but reached the quota. Ops requested increase last week but not approved for this billing cycle.

devin: Okay. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce queue pressure by throttling non-critical Hosted traffic to this pool, 2) move two Dedicated tenants to an alternative pool in us-east-1 as temporary failover, 3) restart affected drivers gracefully if possible, 4) file quota emergency with cloud provider. Who can run the throttling?

mira: I can push a temporary routing rule in the gateway to divert 40% of traffic for the next 30m. Will apply canary first.

sam: I'll open the quota ticket and ping our account rep. ETA 15m for confirmation.

jordan: For driver restarts: on ai-gpu-07 and ai-gpu-09 we saw OOM traces before Xid events. Suggest we run a controlled drain and node reboot sequence so kernels come up cleanly. I'll coordinate with infra.

devin: Do that. Also, let's strip non-essential model variants from this pool to free up memory on the GPUs (reload smaller quantized variants if available). Mira, can you toggle model-routing?

mira: Yes. Pushing variant downgrade for routes: `model: rw-kuiper-v2` -> `rw-kuiper-v2-4bit`. Doing it in 5m canary groups.

support-bot: Notifying affected Dedicated customers: tenant-a and tenant-b. Draft message in #support-dedicated ready for approval: "We're experiencing reduced capacity in EU; some requests may be delayed. We're migrating impacted workloads and expect improvement in 30-60 minutes."

customer-success: Please hold on messaging until we confirm fallback migration. We don't want to alarm customers prematurely. If we start move, include guidance about potential model variant differences.

devin: Status update: router canary applied (40% diverted to cross-region pool). Initial metrics: queue at 128 -> 76 in 3m. Latency for canary reduced to baseline. Backlog still 64 on remaining nodes.

jordan: Infra team started controlled drain of ai-gpu-07. Found kernel OOM trace pointing to large KV cache retention on older driver. Rebooting node now.

sam: Cloud quota support responded: can provision +6 GPUs for 2 hours if we sign emergency procurement. Request sent, waiting approval from finance.

mira: Model downgrade rollout started. Early failure rate unchanged for some heavy prompts; need to adjust batching on the smaller variants. Leaving note for Optimize team.

devin: We should also enable aggressive prefix cache eviction for this pool to reduce KV size. Can a runtime engineer push `kv.cache.max_entries=1000`?

jordan: Pushed eviction flag to nodes still healthy. Evictions visible in runtime logs.

oncall-bot: Update: ai-gpu-07 back online after reboot. Node shows 0 Xid events in last 4m. Rejoined pool.

mira: After ai-gpu-07 rejoin, backlog dipped from 64 -> 38. Good.

sam: Finance approved emergency procurement. Cloud will spin up +6 GPUs in 12m. Estimated join in 15-20m.

devin: Great. Let's keep the router canary at 40% until extra nodes are joinable, then slowly ramp down. Also we should document this as an autoscaler policy gap: max_nodes equals quota; autoscaler should surface quota-blocking alerts earlier.

jordan: Agreed. Postmortem actions: 1) autoscaler add quota check and early alert + remediation playbook, 2) driver: blacklist old kernel-driver combo that causes KV retention leak, 3) product: enable cross-region migration for Dedicated tenants in console.

support-bot: Approved customer message queued, will send after you confirm migration start.

customer-success: Send messaging now. Include expected ETA 30-45m and mention we're prioritizing tenant-a and tenant-b.

mira: Sending message now.

devin: Current metrics at 09:48: queue=22, effective GPUs active=22 (two nodes still rebooting), Xid events = 0 in last 10m. Throttling reduced error surface.

jordan: Autoscaler event log shows scale_resume after quota clearance; new nodes expected to join and should bring queue to <5.

mira: Thanks everyone. I'll start the incident doc skeleton and capture the timeline. We'll run a full postmortem later with action owners.

devin: Incident resolved: backlog drained, latencies back to normal. Marking state -> monitoring. :thumbsup:"
